title: Maximum and Minimum Distances
author: 3iGR44tcGMnRnhEYm
chapter_outcomes: Understand the relations between Cartesian and Polar coordinates, and convert equations of curves from Cartesian to polar form and vice versa
Sketch simple polar curves, for $0 \le \theta < 2\pi$ or $−\pi < \theta \le \pi$ or a subset of either of these intervals
Recall the formula $\frac{1}{2} \int r^2 d\theta$ for the area of a sector, and use this formula in simple cases
